opening.caption: The lookout needs supplies. A crossing must be made safe before we go.

returnBasic.caption: Tell me what you saw. The bridge and the ford each need a different safety check.

returnBridge.caption: You found the damaged deck. Check the rack as well. Are the spare boards the same length as the gap?

returnFord.caption: You checked the water. Compare your reading with the posted limit, then show me where the stones lead.

directionFord.caption: The ford is downstream. Look for white stones and check the water depth.

directionBridge.caption: Measure the gap in the bridge. Check the spare boards on the tool rack. The inspection tag tells you about the supports.

authorizedBridge.caption: Those measurements match. Collect the two boards from the tool rack. Then fetch the rope and secure it on the bridge.

authorizedFord.caption: The ford is within the posted limit. I will release the markers and the supply pack.

retryEvidence.caption: I need both observations for that plan. Check your field evidence and try again.

unsafe.caption: Stop here. The water at the bridge is thirty-eight centimetres deep. Look downstream and compare the ford to its limit.

reportBridge.caption: The supports are sound. Now tell me which crossing you recommend.

reportMissing.caption: Go to the north edge of the clearing and look for the missing boards.

deliveryInProgress.caption: Watch the crossing. Meet me here when I have delivered the pack.

endingBridge.caption: The bridge is open. Your two boards are secure. The supply pack is now at the lookout.

endingFord.caption: Your flags mark the white stones. The supplies are at the lookout. The bridge is still closed.
